checks.description: Its statuses (Appendix C.1 #28, #29; ENG-20, ENG-21): every problem the posting rules find in its content, as Templates incomplete (✖); a warning when an occurrence before today has no draft yet; or OK, Paused or Ended.

content_version.description: The version of its content, which drafts name; it changes when the memo, lines or reversal change.

debits.description: The total of its debit lines, per currency.

edited_at.description: When the current content was written.

edited_by.description: Who wrote the current content: they do not approve the posting of its drafts (SOD-3).

last_on.description: The last occurrence a draft was made for.

next_on.description: The next occurrence the scheduler makes a draft for, on that day; absent once it has ended.

reverses.description: Each draft reverses by itself on the first day of the next month.

status.description: active makes its drafts; paused makes none until it is resumed; ended has no occurrence left.

version.description: The version of the recurring journal; it makes the ETag.
